title: lig200 cyc3 & cyc4 re-submission (Sequencing)
body:
SELEX cleanup

Repeat a cleanup with about 300 uL of the fresh sample:

0.9-0.6

- Add 180 uL (0.6X) beads to each sample. Incubate 10 mins, RT.
- Bind to magnet for 5 mins.
- Move supernatant to new tubes and then add (300 x (0.9 - 0.6) = 90 uL). Incubate 10 mins at RT. Bind for 5 mins to magnet.
- Remove supernatant and wash twice with 300 uL 85% ethanol. Air dry for 2-3 mins.
- Elute each sample in 100 uL of TE buffer at 37 C.
- Run Qubit and TS (D5000)
